field_descriptions.bcc_recipient: A sub property of recipient. The recipient blind copied on a message.
field_descriptions.cc_recipient: A sub property of recipient. The recipient copied on a message.
field_descriptions.date_read: The date/time at which the message has been read by the recipient if a single recipient exists.
field_descriptions.date_received: The date/time the message was received if a single recipient exists.
field_descriptions.date_sent: The date/time at which the message was sent.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.message_attachment: A CreativeWork attached to the message.
field_descriptions.recipient: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the receiving end of the action.
field_descriptions.sender: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the sending end of the action.
field_descriptions.to_recipient: A sub property of recipient. The recipient who was directly sent the message.
